purpose: Vertical list of 992x400 post cards, cover image left, tag/title/blurb right, each revealed on scroll.

motion.reducedMotionFallback: opacity:1; transform:none; transition:none (global prefers-reduced-motion rule, src/index.css:80-86)

md-768.description: List top margin grows from the base value to 68px.

nav-810.description: Each post card's image+text stacks vertically below 810px; at 810px it becomes a fixed-height (400px) horizontal row with a fixed 436px-wide thumbnail.
